name: Kolkata Durga Puja Pandals - Pujo Parikrama Companion

properties.name: Bagbazar Sarbojanin Durgotsav
properties.description: One of the oldest and most revered traditional community pujas in Kolkata (founded 1919). Celebrated for its serene, classic Ekchala Sabeki Pratima, magnificent immersion procession, and authentic festive carnival atmosphere.

properties.name: Kumartuli Park Sarbojanin
properties.description: Located in the heart of Kolkata's legendary idol-makers colony. Known for fusing clay sculpture heritage with breathtaking architectural themes and intricate clay craftsmanship.

properties.name: Sovabazar Rajbari (Raja Nabakrishna Deb)
properties.description: Historic Bonedi Bari puja started in 1757 by Raja Nabakrishna Deb. Features the grand Natmandir courtyard, traditional rituals, cannons firing on Sandhi Puja, and unmatched aristocratic Kolkata heritage.
properties.address: 33 and 36, Raja Nabakrishna Street, Sovabazar, Kolkata 700005

properties.name: Hatibagan Sarbojanin Durgotsav
properties.description: A historic crowd puller in North Kolkata with over 85 years of tradition, recognized for exceptional lighting, thoughtful thematic decor, and warm community hospitality.

properties.name: Ahiritola Sarbojanin Durgotsab
properties.description: Renowned for deeply researched socio-cultural themes, ornate installations right beside the Hooghly river ghats, and captivating music & light choreography.

properties.name: Mohammad Ali Park Durga Puja
properties.description: One of Kolkata's most iconic central pujas, famous for replicating grand Indian palaces, castles, and historic temples with glowing illuminated facades.
properties.address: CR Avenue & MG Road Junction, College Street, Kolkata 700073

properties.name: College Square Sarbojanin
properties.description: World-famous for its majestic pandal situated alongside the College Square water reservoir, creating shimmering reflections of thousands of dazzling light displays.

properties.name: Santosh Mitra Square (Lebutala)
properties.description: Consistently features high-octane conceptual wonders such as laser shows, giant replicas of Ram Mandir, Sphere Las Vegas, and intricate gold-leaf deities.
properties.address: St. James Square, Lebutala, Bowbazar, Kolkata 700012

properties.name: Sreebhumi Sporting Club
properties.description: The golden crown of VIP Road Durga Puja parikrama. Celebrated for replicating global architectural landmarks (Burj Khalifa, Vatican City, Disneyland, etc.) with real gold and diamond ornaments on the goddess.
properties.address: Canal Street, Sreebhumi, Lake Town, Kolkata 700048

properties.name: Dum Dum Park Tarun Sangha
properties.description: A vanguard of contemporary installation art in Bengal. Every year presents thought-provoking themes utilizing unconventional materials and mesmerizing ambient music.
properties.address: Dum Dum Park, Salt Lake Bypass, Kolkata 700055

properties.name: Dum Dum Park Bharat Chakra
properties.description: Celebrated for rustic indigenous handicrafts, intricate bamboo, terracotta, and folk artistry from rural Bengal and North Eastern India.
properties.address: Dum Dum Park, Lake Town, Kolkata 700055

properties.name: FD Block Sarbojanin Salt Lake
properties.description: Salt Lake's most celebrated mega-pandal, famous for transforming the FD Block park into royal forts, ancient Buddhist monasteries, and fantasy landscapes.
properties.address: FD Block Park, Sector 3, Bidhannagar, Kolkata 700091

properties.name: BJ Block Sarbojanin Salt Lake
properties.description: A beloved cultural heartland of Salt Lake, offering serene community festivities, authentic Bengali cultural performances, and intricate traditional design.
properties.address: BJ Block Park, Sector 2, Bidhannagar, Kolkata 700091

properties.name: Maddox Square (Ritchie Road)
properties.description: The legendary epicenter of Kolkata's festive youth culture, open-air Adda, live dhak beats, and traditional Sabeki idol under a massive illuminated canopy.
properties.famousFor: The Quintessential Durga Puja Adda & Dhak
properties.address: Maddox Square Park, Ritchie Rd, Ballygunge, Kolkata 700019

properties.name: Ekdalia Evergreen Club
properties.description: Established in 1945, famous for preserving genuine traditional Pratima, breathtaking German chandeliers, and monumental glowing replicas of famous Indian temples.

properties.name: Singhi Park Sarbojanin
properties.description: Located right opposite Ekdalia, Singhi Park is celebrated for majestic temple replicas, flawless lighting artistry from Chandannagar, and regal presentation.
properties.address: Gariahat Road, Dover Terrace, Ballygunge, Kolkata 700019

properties.name: Ballygunge Cultural Association
properties.description: A pioneering cultural institution blending modern artistic refinement with deep Bengali classical literature, art, and traditional values.

properties.name: Tridhara Sammilani
properties.description: Situated at the junction of Rashbehari Avenue and Manohar Pukur Road. Renowned for award-winning architectural innovations and poignant social narratives.
properties.address: Rashbehari Avenue & Manohar Pukur Rd, Kolkata 700029

properties.name: Deshapriya Park Durgotsav
properties.description: A landmark south Kolkata puja celebrated for monumental installations and historic scale, attracting hundreds of thousands of visitors every festive night.

properties.name: Mudiali Club
properties.description: Known as the gem of Lake Road. Celebrated for pristine eco-friendly materials, gentle traditional illumination, and soothing devotional aesthetics.
properties.address: Lake Avenue & Southern Avenue, Mudiali, Kolkata 700026

properties.name: Shiv Mandir Sarbojanin Durgotsav
properties.description: Renowned for atmospheric installations that fuse sacred traditions with contemporary installation art along the serene shores of Rabindra Sarobar.
properties.address: Lake Temple Road, Rabindra Sarobar, Kolkata 700029

properties.name: Suruchi Sangha (New Alipore)
properties.description: Each year, Suruchi Sangha adopts a unique Indian state or cultural region, creating authentic handicraft architecture, indigenous music, and iconic festival songs.
properties.address: 500/A, BL Saha Road, New Alipore, Kolkata 700053

properties.name: Chetla Agrani Club
properties.description: A perennial powerhouse in theme pujas, crafting mesmerizing rural Bengali village setups, terracotta temples, and hand-carved wood and stone motifs.

properties.name: Badamtala Ashar Sangha
properties.description: Over 80 years old, legendary for winning numerous creative awards through subtle, poignant themes and deeply emotional artistic expressions.

properties.name: 66 Pally Club
properties.description: Located adjacent to Badamtala, celebrated for empowering women priestesses, eco-friendly handloom installations, and social reform messages.

properties.name: Behala Natun Dal
properties.description: A standout titan of South Suburban Kolkata, celebrated for expansive artistic installations that immerse parikrama travelers into surreal visual landscapes.
properties.address: 14/1/1 Dhyan Niranjan Sen Sarani, Behala, Kolkata 700034

properties.name: Behala Club Sarbojanin
properties.description: Showcases authentic traditional craft forms, intricate brass bell chimes, woven cane work, and heartwarming community warmth.

properties.name: Babubagan Club Sarbojanin
properties.description: Famous for spectacular replicas of ancient Indian temple stone carvings and coin-based or glass-cut heritage themes.

properties.name: Selimpur Pally Durgotsav
properties.description: Renowned for rustic themes highlighting the rich traditions of rural Bengal artists, weavers, and farmers.

properties.name: Jodhpur Park Sarbojanin
properties.description: One of the most popular community celebrations in South Kolkata, noted for blend of modern technology, dynamic lighting, and festive fanfare.

properties.name: Naktala Udayan Sangha
properties.description: A crown jewel of deep South Kolkata parikrama, known for daring conceptual installations, avant-garde idols, and poetic festival atmospheres.

properties.name: Bosepukur Sitala Mandir Durgotsab
properties.description: The historic pioneer that revolutionized theme pujas in Kolkata (famed for the earthen cup 'bhaar' pandal). Continues to create iconic indigenous thematic marvels.
properties.famousFor: Pioneers of Kolkata Thematic Clay Art

properties.name: Manicktalla Chaltabagan Lohapatty
properties.description: Famous for its energetic Dhunuchi dance competitions, celebrity visits, and majestic glittering glass and brass pandals.
properties.address: Raja Rammohan Roy Sarani, Manicktala, Kolkata 700009

properties.name: Tala Barowari Durgotsab
properties.description: Over a century old community puja renowned for maintaining pristine traditional Bengali customs, community bhog, and exquisite traditional Pratima.
